title: Molecular dynamics simulations reveal DNA gate opening mechanisms for M. smegmatis topoisomerase 1A.
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和伞形采样模拟拓扑异构酶1A的DNA门控开放机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作动态机理研究，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象非TF-DNA。
abstract: Type 1A topoisomerases relax torsional strain in DNA via a strand passage mechanism in which a protein-mediated DNA gate must open during the enzyme's catalytic cycle. This gate-open conformational state of the enzyme has been challenging to observe via experimental methods. In this study, we first used equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations to probe the structural properties of the gate-closed state for the DNA-free apo system and a system with an ssDNA bound at the DNA binding site. For both systems, we followed the equilibrium simulations with umbrella sampling simulations. Umbrella sampling allowed us to bias the protein to adopt a gate-open state to study the properties of this conformation, as well as the pathways leading to it. We observed that several electrostatic interactions contribute to the closed-state stability of the protein, which were broken during the gate opening. The gate opening composed of three major domain motions that were determined from simulation trajectories and principal component analysis. Finally, umbrella sampling results combined with the weighted histogram analysis method allowed us to reconstruct the free energy profiles of gate opening for all simulations.
abstract_zh: 1A型拓扑异构酶通过链穿过机制松弛DNA中的扭转应力，在该机制中，酶催化循环期间必须打开一个由蛋白质介导的DNA门。该酶的此门开放构象状态一直难以通过实验方法观察。在本研究中，我们首先使用平衡分子动力学 (equilibrium molecular dynamics) 模拟来探测无DNA的apo系统以及一个在DNA结合位点结合有ssDNA的系统的门关闭状态的结构特性。对于这两个系统，我们在平衡模拟之后进行了伞形采样 (umbrella sampling) 模拟。伞形采样使我们能够偏置蛋白质以采用门开放状态，从而研究该构象的特性以及通向该构象的路径。我们观察到，若干静电相互作用有助于蛋白质关闭状态的稳定性，而这些相互作用在门打开过程中被破坏。门打开由三个主要结构域运动组成，这些运动通过模拟轨迹和主成分分析 (principal component analysis) 确定。最后，伞形采样结果结合加权直方图分析法 (weighted histogram analysis method) 使我们能够重建所有模拟中门打开的 free energy profiles。
